content: {"summary":"The fraud‑scorer pod was OOMKilled twice because its memory limit was almost exhausted: with WEB_CONCURRENCY unset it ran 16 workers (~150 MiB each) leaving little headroom, and each redis‑features latency spike grew the feature cache until the remaining memory was consumed.","likely_cause":"Tight memory budget from 16 workers plus feature‑cache growth during redis‑features latency spikes","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"WEB_CONCURRENCY was unset, so the pod ran one worker per visible core","evidence_ids":["INC-0097#0"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY is unset, so the pod runs one worker per visible core"},{"text":"Each warm worker used about 150 MiB, leaving limited memory for the cache","evidence_ids":["INC-0097#0"],"quote":"At about 150 MiB per warm worker that is 2,400 MiB before any cache growth, inside a 3,072 MiB limit"},{"text":"Redis latency spikes filled the feature cache, exhausting the remaining memory","evidence_ids":["INC-0097#0","INC-0097#1"],"quote":"each slow stretch on redis-features filled it"}],"next_checks":["Check the current WEB_CONCURRENCY configuration for fraud‑scorer pods","Monitor redis‑features latency and correlate with feature‑cache size","Measure feature‑cache growth rate during slow stretches","Evaluate increasing the pod memory limit or reducing worker count"]}
